# Architecture

<!-- Generated by .github/scripts/generate_documents.py; edit source records instead. -->


## Actual-state governance

### Decision

Use a status-gated source-record system: published notes generate README; approved requests generate PRD; accepted decisions generate ARCHITECTURE; active rules generate AGENTS. The generated files are deterministic, committed and never edited separately.

Repository documents describe **only current tracked/observed capabilities**. Implementation designs, API shapes, data schemas, target diagrams and future rules belong only in GitHub issues, not in generated PRD or architectural records.

### Consequences

Every PR with an implementation or governance change updates the affected source records, regenerates all affected outputs, checks their exactness, and labels any unverified external behavior BLOCKED rather than IMPLEMENTED.

_Source: [0001-source-records.md](decisions/0001-source-records.md)_


## Native directories and repository-owned tests

### Decision

Keep independent physical `.github/` and `.agents/` directories, the repository's entire test suite under `.github/tests/`, roles and skills in `.agents/agents/` and `.agents/skills/`, and the existing repository-owned `.darkfactory/installation.json` integration metadata. Distinguish historical assignment references from diagrams generated from actual source. Proposed implementation diagrams live in issues, not in `.agents/requirements/`.

### Consequences

GitHub Actions remains natively discoverable; there is no mirrored test, workflow, DarkFactory source or speculative API/SQL/JSON authority.

_Source: [0002-layout.md](decisions/0002-layout.md)_


## Actual branch and review controls

### Decision

The repository's integration and release controls are the ones actually enforced by GitHub. Implementation PRs remain issue-bound and require independent maintainer review and explicit approval of their final revisions. Passing CI is necessary but not sufficient.

### Consequences

Any alternative branch topology or release policy remains issue-only until its implementation and native GitHub enforcement are verified. Do not describe an unconfigured branch policy as active.

_Source: [0003-review.md](decisions/0003-review.md)_


## Versioning and release ownership

### Decision

`repo.dfconfig` uses DarkFactory PrideVer; no separate tag-only or `VERSION`-file authority should be installed. The tracked `.github/workflows/release.yml` accepts main pushes and manual dispatch, and can publish development prereleases.

### Consequences

Any change to release authorization, branch topology or provider enforcement must be captured in its owning issue and implemented together with tested GitHub settings. Source policy by itself does not prove provider enforcement.

_Source: [0004-release.md](decisions/0004-release.md)_


## Implemented source boundaries

### Decision

The checked-in Python source under `packages/engine/` owns its app entry point, controller and models; chess and checkers JSON assets live under their respective `packages/` directories. Documentation building and GitHub workflow automation live in `.github/`. Source-derived Mermaid diagrams represent those tracked source declarations.

### Consequences

No client app, FastAPI multiplayer lifecycle, Supabase schema, declarative engine contract, or native distribution is implemented by this governance PR. Proposed application architecture and acceptance criteria are tracked only in [#350](https://github.com/marius-patrik/BoardGamesWithQuests/issues/350) and dependent issues, to be documented in-repo only when corresponding code lands.

_Source: [0005-existing-code.md](decisions/0005-existing-code.md)_


## Portable agent roles and skills

### Decision

Keep the five repository-local roles (orchestrator, planner, implementer, reviewer and verifier) in `.agents/agents/` and task-focused procedures in `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`. All roles inherit generated `.agents/AGENTS.md`; procedures supplement rather than override approved requirements, human review or security controls.

### Consequences

These Markdown records are portable guidance, not a competing agent runtime. They do not prove a particular execution provider has discovered, installed or invoked a role or skill. Review and verification require reproducible evidence before a maintainer authorizes merge.

_Source: [0006-agent-roles-and-skills.md](decisions/0006-agent-roles-and-skills.md)_
